title: weekday takes the day as written, YYYY-MM-DD, since every caller had to parse it first; weekday was not among the functions the first step described
covers: an entry with no stated kinds
what it accepts changes from a day to text
the tool's form and the printed declaration both say "anything"
note: calendar's own tests pass. reports calls weekday(parseDay(b.day)): parseDay is now handed a Date, finds no YYYY-MM-DD in its text and throws a RangeError; reports' first test fails. weekday is (any) => string before and after, in the tool's form and in the printed declaration, so nobody is told.
